title: Curcuma longa tea for medicinal use
intro: Curcuma longa tea is a herbal preparation made from the dried rhizomes of the Curcuma longa plant, commonly known as turmeric. This tea is traditionally used in herbalism for its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and digestive properties. It is often consumed to support joint health, reduce inflammation, and promote overall well-being. In many cultures, it is also used to aid digestion and support liver function. Its active compound, curcumin, is believed to contribute to its therapeutic effects.
